summary: End-to-end testing of Smartize Outreach MVP (backend pytest + frontend Playwright). All 31 backend tests pass. All frontend nav routes, auth guard, and key modal test-ids verified working.
critical_code_review_comments: Nav data-testids use accented labels (e.g. nav-estatísticas, nav-configurações). Works but fragile — consider ASCII slugs.
GET /api/contacts caps at 5000 documents (to_list(5000)) — add pagination for scale.
Dashboard daily loop makes ~28 DB round-trips per request; batch with aggregation for perf.
api.py exceeds 600 lines — consider splitting into routers/modules (contacts, campaigns, tracking).
cancel_campaign returns 200 even when campaign_id doesn't exist (no matched_count check). Same for archive/delete/reply.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST_ prefixed groups, contacts, templates, smtp, campaigns via pytest teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests must be run serially with `-n 0` because pytest.ini enforces `-n 2 --dist loadscope` and tests share class-level state across TestGroups→TestContacts→TestCampaigns. Nav testids are Portuguese labels lowercased with accents preserved: nav-dashboard, nav-contactos, nav-grupos, nav-templates, nav-campanhas, nav-smtp, nav-estatísticas, nav-deliverability, nav-configurações.
